<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Protests and political unrest:</strong> INDIA bloc leaders are set to march to the Supreme Court and hold nationwide protests demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner following allegations of violence and election irregularities.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPZ2l3dnNJczdwOGNWVTlXclFHcE10Y1NNTUpJVzRublJDYjk0WXItWEpvU1NNSVFWdkFneEdSYkgzdFdPSng3WTFXZ1BNQVF1RGE5bWtKdFlQTXUzYzhwR0JoeWNRclkzNlpXamxwV0U0WkRtLXVmcWJOMG1VOEZMOW9UUnZWU1Z0dVluUjNORnhBZ2xCY0p1TEh0V2xRQkoxWEFZR3hGTVVxSm5GcHV4S1ZDV2d1aXBBRGc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>BJP-Opposition standoff:</strong> The BJP has asserted that the country must be governed through Parliament rather than street protests, while accusing opposition leaders of attempting to incite anarchy with foreign influence.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Internal party dissent:</strong> A two-term BJP MP has resigned from the party following a snub regarding a Rajya Sabha ticket nomination.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Delimitation concerns:</strong> Rahul Gandhi has criticized the national delimitation process, alleging it is a strategic design to diminish the political voice of Tamil Nadu in Parliament.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial review of election laws:</strong> The Supreme Court has reserved its judgment regarding the legal parameters under which the Election Commission may bypass bye-elections as per Section 151A of the Representation of the People Act.</li>
</ul>
